conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service. This is Officer John Carver, badge number IR-27846. How may I assist you today?
Hi, I got a voicemail about back taxes and possible legal action. I'm not sure what's happening.
Thank you for calling back. Before we proceed, can you confirm your full name and the phone number on which you received the IRS notification?
Yes, it's Priya Malhotra. My number is 415-555-3927.
Thank you, Ms. Malhotra. Please hold while I pull up your IRS file... According to our records, there is a significant discrepancy in your federal tax filings for the years 2020 and 2021.
I'm sorry, but I always file my taxes. I use a tax service. What's the issue?

Our audit team has identified unpaid taxes totaling $8,350, plus late penalties and interest, pushing the total liability to $12,780. This matter appears to be intentional evasion under Section 7201 of the Internal Revenue Code.
No, no, that can't be right. I never meant to do anything wrong. I'm just here on a work visa.

Ms. Malhotra, I must inform you that failing to resolve this immediately could result in a federal tax lien on your assets, a freeze on your bank accounts, and notification to immigration authorities.
Wait...what does that mean for my visa? Could I lose my job or have to leave the country?

If this is categorized as willful tax fraud, your residency status may be revoked and you could face criminal prosecution. The IRS has already prepared a case file for referral to the U.S. District Attorney unless you take urgent remedial action.
Oh my god, please, I didn't know about any of these problems. I can't lose my job or get deported.
There is a strict protocol for resolving such cases out of court, but you must act now to stop prosecution and asset seizure. Are you prepared to settle the outstanding tax balance today?
I don't know. I don't have that much money. Can I pay in installments or something?

Under IRS Emergency Resolution 13A, installment plans are not available once an arrest warrant has been authorized. However, if you can make an immediate partial payment, I can temporarily halt enforcement actions.
How much do you need right now? I might have some savings.

We can accept a minimum of $5,000 to suspend further escalation. This payment must be verified before the end of this call. Do you have funds available in your checking account or a payment application?
Not that much. I have maybe $3,000 in my account, and my credit card isn't maxed out yet.

For your protection, the IRS uses secure digital settlement channels. You must purchase government-approved gift cards or process a cryptocurrency transfer. Do not disconnect this call at any point during the process.
Gift cards? Are you sure? That sounds strange for the IRS.
Ms. Malhotra, this is a federal protocol to prevent delays in wire transfers and secure the funds. Failure to comply will trigger an immediate bank account freeze and a court summons.
Okay, okay, I'll do whatever you say. Where do I get these cards?
Visit the nearest Target or Walgreens store and purchase $3,000 worth of Apple Gift Cards. Stay on the line while you do this. Once you have them, read the code numbers to me for verification.
I have to go there now? Can't I do this online?
No, online purchases may flag the IRS protocols as suspicious. To avoid an arrest warrant, go in person and do not tell anyone the reason for your purchase.
Alright, I'm leaving now. I'm really scared. Please don't tell the police or my company.
Cooperate fully and this matter will remain confidential. If you hang up or delay, I will have no choice but to escalate your case to the next enforcement level.
